01Our core business is the sale of domestic wastewater treatment plants and rainwater tanks.

Our core business is the sale of domestic wastewater treatment plants and rainwater tanks.

If your planned project already has design documentation and the relevant building permit, it is the ideal time to order suitable technology.

We deliver the wastewater treatment plant to the building site. As it is a water management structure whose commissioning and operation require specific knowledge, it has to be commissioned by qualified professionals. Among other things, commissioning includes training the future operator and handing over the necessary documentation.

02Rainwater tanks and accessories are not as demanding to install, so anyone can do it themselves.

Rainwater tanks and accessories are not as demanding to install, so anyone can do it themselves. If needed, though, we are always ready to install and commission our products as well.

Every project is different and clients' requirements vary. For a quote, please contact us and give us the basic details of your planned project. We will be delighted to prepare a quote for you.
